how_opened: GHF, directed by the Transaction Committee (03/24/2016), contacted 29 potential buyers (11 strategic, 18 financial); management also approached two more Class I railroads.
who_was_in: 25 NDA signers: 11 strategic (Party A named; G&W and Party B also signed) and 14 financial.
bids_received: 9 unnamed whole-company bidders (nine IOIs, $17.93–$26.50); no Other-scope bids.
how_it_ended: Seven advanced; two low bidders dropped; sixteen did not submit (Party A and 15 others). IOIs arrived through 06/01/2016; bidders not named.

how_opened: GHF asked the seven advanced bidders for non-binding LOIs with mark-ups of the merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement.
who_was_in: 8: seven advanced (strategic: G&W, Party B, Party E, Party F, one unnamed; financial: Party D, one unnamed) plus late strategic entrant Party C.
bids_received: 6: Party B, G&W, Party E, Party D, Party C, Party F; no Other-scope bids.
bidders_bid: genesee & wyoming inc; party b; party c; party d; party e; party f
how_it_ended: Two advanced (G&W, Party B); four dropped (Parties C, D, E, F); two did not submit. G&W missed the 07/20/2016 due date (LOI 07/21/2016) but continued.

how_opened: Transaction Committee chose G&W and Party B for confirmatory diligence and merger agreement negotiation (definitive negotiation).
who_was_in: 2 strategic: G&W and Party B; Parties D (financial) and E (strategic) re-entered 07/29/2016.
bids_received: 4: G&W, Party B (reaffirmed), Party D, Party E; no Other-scope bids.
bidders_bid: genesee & wyoming inc; party b; party d; party e
how_it_ended: Signing with G&W at $25.00 cash on 08/12/2016; Party B and Party E not selected; Party D withdrew.
